query: WanAnimate + WanVideoAnimateEmbeds with bg_images connected + context options crashes: image_cond[:, c] IndexError at nodes_sampler.py:1903 because provided bg_images is encoded at raw length instead of num_frames-num_refs.

desired.outcome: Booyaka101 reproduced and root-caused it: provided bg is encoded at raw length (nodes.py:1281, no resize) while the None case builds bg at num_frames-num_refs; shorter bg -> shorter ref_latent -> IndexError, longer bg -> cat mismatch, and num_frames rounding to 4k+1 desyncs even matched lengths. Patch normalizing bg (truncate/last-frame-pad) offered as PR; not merged/confirmed.
